serp_review.observation: Results were Google's own help page (several locale variants), general operator lists (leavemealone.com, rightinbox.com, mailmeteor.com), a find-oldest-emails guide (getinboxzero.com) and a university IT tip (it.fitnyc.edu). The search summary showed recipe pairings (category:promotions older_than:6m, from: + older_than, larger:10M older_than:1y). Pages were not opened individually; none of the snippets showed age bands with newer_than or braces/minus composition with an age condition.
serp_review.limitation: One standard US web search; result pages were not opened, so the composition claim about competitors rests on titles/snippets only. The search summary asserted operators are case-sensitive; this is unverified and was deliberately not used.

information_gain: A composition reference for the operator itself: a unit-conversion table (weeks to days, 1.5y to 18m) and a table pairing older_than with each documented combining operator (category, age band with newer_than, braces OR across senders, minus exclusion, label, in:anywhere, larger), plus the brace-placement rule so the age applies to every OR alternative, a build-one-condition-at-a-time procedure, and why minus exclusions and age cutoffs both leak through mixed conversations. Existing guides give 3-4 single recipes (gmail-search-operators-to-find-old-emails), the one-year cleanup (hub) or, in the pending draft gmail-older-than-not-working, mistyped-syntax troubleshooting; none cover newer_than bands, braces or minus with an age condition.
overlap_check: Strong adjacent overlap with published gmail-search-operators-to-find-old-emails (operator recipes) and the hub. Distinctness rests on the combination table; the draft links to both for recipes/cleanup and does not repeat a deletion walkthrough. It deliberately keeps syntax troubleshooting short to avoid gmail-older-than-not-working (pending, draft exists) and only one line on before: to avoid gmail-older-than-vs-before (pending). A reviewer may reasonably decide the gain is too thin and merge the combination table into gmail-search-operators-to-find-old-emails as a refresh instead.
limitations: Source and documentation review only; no live Gmail mailbox test was run. Results for the combined queries were not observed.

Implicit AND for spaces, brace placement behaviour with an age condition and in:anywhere being needed for Spam/Trash are inferred from Google's documented operators, not explicitly stated for older_than.
